subject: Urgent: request for backfill exemption - Senior SRE coverage during perf cycle
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: request for backfill exemption - Senior SRE coverage during perf cycle

Hi Laura / Marcus,

Quick summary: Samira (Senior SRE) just accepted the Director offer in our infra org and will transition out at the end of July. Her role is critical for the July->August on-call rotation and the upcoming performance calibration cycle. Given we are mid-review and several calibration notes depend on Samira's input (escapes + SVT ownership), we need a short-term plan to avoid a coverage gap that would materially increase SLO exposure.

Request: approval for a hiring-freeze exemption to either:
- Option A: immediate backfill hire (req open, full FTE)
- Option B: 3-month contractor with SRE bench rate (faster start, capped cost)

Attached: headcount_request_form.pdf and org_chart_v2.png (shows reporting lines and critical on-call distribution).

Why now: next week's calibration meeting requires Samira or a designated SME to validate severity buckets and postmortem actions. If we wait for the standard hiring cycle, we risk delayed fixes and elevated incident risk.

Decision ask: Can you confirm a route (A or B) by EOD tomorrow so we can engage People Ops / Talent? If we go with B, Marcus — can you share an estimated budget impact?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: headcount_request_form.pdf (fillable), org_chart_v2.png
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Joan Harris <joan.harris@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: request for backfill exemption - Senior SRE coverage during perf cycle

Thanks Kim — looped in Stephanie for HR/People Ops intake and Joan from Acme to keep them aware of potential coverage changes that could affect the integration work with their SRE team.

Proposed short mutual action plan:
- Today: agreement from leadership on A vs B (Kim / Marcus).
- Tomorrow AM: Stephanie to initiate hiring-freeze exemption workflow and post provisional approval to HC tracker (link below).
- By EOD tomorrow: if Option B, Talent to present 2 contractor candidates; if Option A, open req and expedite interview slate.

I don't want to approve a permanent FTE without a reprioritization conversation, but I'm supportive of a time-boxed contractor to cover the perf window and on-call handoffs. If Marcus can quantify cost delta, we'll include that in the waiver.

Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HC-984 (temporary waiver request)

Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Joan Harris <joan.harris@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: request for backfill exemption - Senior SRE coverage during perf cycle

On Mon, Jul 19, 2027 at 09:03, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Kim — looped in Stephanie for HR/People Ops intake and Joan from Acme to keep them aware...

Agree with a time-boxed approach. Quick cost/impact note: (estimates below are rough, final numbers in attached cost_breakdown.xlsx)

Option A (permanent backfill):
- Time to onboard + full ramp ~ 10–12 weeks
- FY run rate delta: ~$180k–$210k (salary + benefits)
- Impact: full ownership restored, long-term capacity but longer risk window during perf cycle

Option B (3-month contractor):
- Start in 1–2 weeks
- 3-month cost estimate (contractor hourly): ~$45k–$60k
- Impact: immediate coverage for on-call and perf calibration, lower cost, no permanent HC increment

Option C (internal rotation):
- Reassign two Senior ICs for on-call rotation for 8 weeks
- Cost: near-zero direct dollars, potential velocity/perf review impact across teams

Recommendation: approve Option B now (contractor) and conditionally approve Option A if after 8 weeks we see sustained load/attrition. That minimizes immediate SLO risk and keeps HC budget flexible.

Attachment stubs: cost_breakdown.xlsx

Marcus
Head of Site Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Joan Harris <joan.harris@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: request for backfill exemption - Senior SRE coverage during perf cycle

Thanks all — HR has reviewed the intake and we can approve a limited exception for a 12-week contractor to cover the critical window. Conditions:

- Contractor must be engaged via our approved vendor list and rate cap (details in HC-984).
- Talent to provide candidate slate within 48 hours of request submission.
- If after 8 weeks the workload or defect rate remains elevated, leadership must reconvene to evaluate permanent backfill and reprioritize open reqs (formal re-eval required by 2027-09-01).

I've created the waiver in the HC tracker and added provisional approval notes. See: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HC-984

Please reply-all to confirm you want HR to proceed with vendor outreach.

Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Manager, People Ops
Redwood Inference
